name: Hawk Barrens
description: Hawk Barrens is a small, scoured desert world whose surface alternates between rust-colored dust seas and smooth glass plains that flash blinding reflections of the nearby sun. The thin atmosphere provides no protection from solar radiation, and the temperature extremes between day and night side exceed a hundred degrees in the equatorial regions. Solar wind has etched the exposed bedrock into flowing, aerodynamic patterns that point uniformly away from the sun, giving the terrain a wind-tunnel quality of frozen motion.

The landscape is beautiful in the way that destruction can be beautiful, every surface shaped by forces that would annihilate anything soft or living. The glass plains ring underfoot like struck crystal, and the dust seas shift in the thin wind with a whispering sound that is more vibration than noise. Radiation levels on the sunlit surface exceed safe exposure limits within minutes for unshielded personnel, and the glass plains focus the solar energy into hotspots where the ground temperature can melt soft metals.

Radiation hotspots of anomalous intensity cluster in the glass plain regions, their energy signatures suggesting a source beyond simple solar concentration. Geological analysis of the glass composition reveals trace elements consistent with high-energy weapons discharge rather than natural cataclysm, raising the possibility that the plains were created deliberately. No other evidence of the responsible party has been found, and the glass has been dated to approximately fifty thousand years, old enough to predate all known spacefaring civilizations in the region.

Hawk Barrens holds interest primarily for those studying the glass plains and their potentially artificial origin. The radiation hazards and extreme conditions make prolonged surface operations costly and dangerous, limiting research to brief drone surveys and shielded sample-collection missions. The silicon and iron deposits are accessible but not valuable enough to justify the operational difficulties. Hawk Barrens is a small, angry world with a violent past, and it punishes curiosity with radiation and heat.
